notes: Same site/access as bs252 (curl tier-1 hit a sustained 429 rate-limit mid-session, escalated to Playwright tier-2 which succeeded for every remaining fetch; curl recovered later for zero-count spot-checks). Discovery: header mega-menu exposes a 'New Arrivals' tab with a parent listing (/collections/new-arrivals) and 7 sub-collections shown in the nav (Wall Lights, Chandeliers, Decor Accents, Flower Vases, Lanterns, Pendant Lights, Floor Lamps). Cross-checked sitemap_collections_1.xml and found the nav under-represents the true set: 9 additional new-arrival-* handles exist (table-lamps, ceiling-lights, picture-lights, jars, wall-baskets, outdoor-hanging-lights, outdoor-wall-lights, outdoor-gate-lights, outdoor-pole-lights) that are not surfaced in the mobile drawer menu at all - all 9 were individually opened/verified. Of these, 3 are currently empty (picture-lights, wall-baskets, outdoor-hanging-lights all verified 0 products via /products.json) and dropped per the zero-product rule; the other 6 have real (small) counts and are included. QTY METHOD: same in-stock-only rendered #ProductCount figure used as qty (see bs252 notes for the reasoning) rather than the raw /products.json membership feed, which is larger for several of these collections because it includes currently out-of-stock items (e.g. new-arrival-table-lamps: rendered 10 vs. raw feed 15). The parent 'New Arrivals' page's own rendered count (207) does NOT equal the sum of its children's counts (375) - this is expected overlap, not an error: the parent page appears to use a different/broader recency window or ranking than the fixed per-category 'new-arrival-<category>' collections, and the site's own per-category taxonomy is preserved as-is rather than reconciled.
